name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India (awarded by your State/UT)
about: A centrally sponsored scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students after Class 10. The State or Union Territory you belong to awards it, with full funding from the Government of India.
benefits: Compulsory fees paid to the college or university (enrolment, tuition, library, games and similar)
Monthly maintenance allowance: degree courses in engineering, medicine, management, computer applications and similar get ₹1,200 (hostel) or ₹550 (day scholar)
B.Pharm, B.Sc Nursing, LLB, hotel management and similar: ₹820 (hostel) or ₹530 (day scholar) a month
Other degrees such as BA, B.Sc and B.Com: ₹570 (hostel) or ₹300 (day scholar) a month
₹1,200 a year for books for correspondence course students, and extra allowances for students with disabilities
eligibilityText: Scheduled Tribe students who have passed Class 10 or a higher examination
Parents' or guardian's income from all sources up to ₹2.50 lakh a year
Studying a recognised post-matric course in a recognised institution in India (some courses such as pilot and aircraft maintenance training are excluded)
You can't hold any other scholarship or stipend at the same time
All children of the same parents can apply

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.50 lakh a year
Not holding another scholarship or stipend

steps.text: Your State or UT awards this scholarship. Read the official guidelines and your state's notice for this year's dates.

steps.title: Apply on the official portal
steps.text: Register and apply on the official portal yourself, and upload the documents it asks for.
